text:
alex: Pinned canary seems to have been misrouted in customer-vpc-3. We pinned 0.1% to canary but seeing ~15% to the blue variant :grimacing:

maria: @alex ugh. Are you sure the routing policy for that VPC uses control-plane routing and not local overrides? :thinking_face:

alex: Control plane routing. control-plane version v2.8.1. Deploy bot shows: deploy-bot: started rollout 1798765420 (canary 0.1% -> canary-pinned)

ops-bot: healthcheck: control-plane heartbeats delayed for vpc customer-vpc-3 (lag 42s) :warning:

devon: Heartbeat lag could cause stale config reads on the edge router. If router falls back to last-known split it might use the older 15% split. Can you paste the rollout config?

alex: Here's the rollout snippet we used:
```yaml
rollout:
  id: canary-2026-03-18
  strategy: percentage
  targets:
    - variant: canary
      percent: 0.1
    - variant: blue
      percent: 99.9
  guards:
    control_plane_staleness_seconds: 10
    fallback_variant: blue
```

maria: Ah — guard is 10s but the heartbeat lag is 42s. Edge routers probably served the older policy (15%). We should have a stricter guard or a decay policy when control plane stale > X.

sanjay: Two quick mitigation ideas: 1) push a short-lived override to the VPC edge to force canary -> 0.1% (manual patch), 2) increase guard to 60s and roll again. Manual override is faster but riskier for air-gapped clusters.

alex: Manual override would require out-of-band signing since this is a private deployment (customer-managed kube). Air-gapped constraints mean we can't push PKI-signed control-plane updates from hosted.

devon: Ok. For private/VPC we should implement a "stale-policy" that when control_plane_staleness > guard_threshold, the router gracefully decays traffic toward the safer variant (fallback) instead of keeping prior larger splits. That avoids manual ops.

maria: Agreed. Also add telemetry: emit rollout_decision_reason on each route decision (stale-heartbeat | live-config | override). We currently just log percent but not the reason.

alex: For immediate action I asked customer to apply the signed override (they have a runbook). They applied, now seeing 0.1% stabilized. But we need platform fixes to prevent recurrence. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: rollout: override applied by customer (runbook-step) at 1798765495

sanjay: Follow-ups: (1) downrev guard to 60s default for private VPCs, (2) implement stale-policy decay algorithm, (3) expose rollout_decision_reason in console and telemetry, (4) ensure deploy-bot emits control_plane_version in rollout events.

maria: I'll open a ticket for UX + telemetry. alex, can you attach the customer log snippets and edge router debug output?

alex: Will paste logs to the ticket. TL;DR — root cause is control-plane staleness + fallback policy retained an older 15% split. Need safer fallback semantics for air-gapped/private.
